name: tool__exec_run
description: Execute an external program (e.g. cargo, gh, npm). Use when you need to run a shell command with structured arguments. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code. Hand agents may only run read-only invocations (e.g. git status, cargo test); mutating commands require head/mind scope.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the program

stdin.description: Optional data to pipe to stdin
